dossier.bear_case: It is a single stock outside the plan, share count is up 5% in a year, and a director sold under a 10b5-1 plan last month. One launch scrub resets the story.
dossier.thesis: ACME grew revenue 24% a year for three years and turned an operating profit in 2025. The launch backlog is two years deep.
dossier.what_would_change:
Two clean launches in a row.
Share count stops growing.
The plan makes room for a satellite sleeve.
dossier.what_it_is: A small company that builds launch vehicles and sells rides to orbit.
dossier.valuation_note: Priced for a launch schedule it has not yet kept.
risks: A failed launch grounds the fleet for months.
It needs to raise cash again within a year.
dossier.fit: It is a single stock outside the plan, half a percent of the book and inside the single-stock band.
dossier.verdict_line: Stay out of more. One scrubbed launch resets the timeline and the price.

dossier.bear_case: The top three holdings are 45% of the fund. A bad quarter for any one of them moves FTEC far more than the S&P 500, and it overlaps a third with the core fund.
dossier.changes_since_last: Top three weight is up 2 points since the June holdings.

sources.title: Your note: keep the tilt at 20%, no higher

dossier.thesis: FTEC is the plan's tech tilt at 20% of the mix. It tracks the broad US tech index for 0.084% a year, and the plan already caps it so one sector can't run the portfolio.
dossier.what_would_change:
Top three weights pass 50%.
Forward P/E above 35x.
The plan drops the tech tilt.
dossier.what_it_is: A fund that owns US technology companies.
dossier.valuation_note: Rich against its own history, held up by fast earnings growth.
risks: Two companies make up over a third of the fund.
Technology falls further than the market in a sell-off.
dossier.fit: It is at the top of its band, so new money goes elsewhere. The tilt is a choice, not the plan’s core.
dossier.verdict_line: Hold. It sits at the top of its band, so new money goes elsewhere.

dossier.bear_case: It still loses money, a follow-on offering is on file, and it would be a new single stock, which the plan rules out.
dossier.changes_since_last: New S-1/A on file since the last look.
dossier.thesis: NOVA is the watchlist's nuclear theme pick. The CEO bought $624K of stock in October and revenue grew 24% last year.
dossier.what_would_change:
Price under $28 with the offering done.
First operating profit.

dossier.what_it_is: A fund that owns the 500 largest US companies in proportion to their size. It makes money when US business as a whole does.
dossier.thesis: It is the cheapest way to own US large companies and it is the core the plan is built around.

valuation_range.basis: price to next year’s earnings, x

dossier.valuation_note: Fair to slightly rich. Earnings growth is carrying the price, not hope.
risks: A third of the fund sits in ten companies.
A US recession hits every holding at once.
dossier.bear_case: It is concentrated in a handful of very large technology companies, and it has not been cheap for years.
dossier.fit: It is 59% of the book against a 60% target, so the next deposit still goes here. It suits a moderate risk level.
dossier.verdict_line: Add on schedule. It is the core of the book and still under its band.
dossier.what_would_change:
It drifts more than 5 points over its target.
The plan changes its core fund.

dossier.what_it_is: A fund that owns companies outside the United States, in developed and emerging markets.
dossier.thesis: It spreads the book beyond one country and one currency, at a lower price than US stocks.

valuation_range.basis: price to next year’s earnings, x

dossier.valuation_note: Cheap against its own history and against US stocks.
risks: A stronger dollar cuts returns for a US holder.
Emerging markets can fall hard and stay down.
dossier.bear_case: It has trailed US stocks for a decade and nothing forces that to end.
dossier.fit: It is 13.7% of the book against a 15% target: the furthest under, so it is first in line for new money.
dossier.verdict_line: Add. It is the furthest under its target.
dossier.what_would_change:
It reaches its target weight.
The plan drops its international sleeve.
